Hi all — looping in as product lead; quick practical suggestion to avoid DST mixups: can we lock the slot in UTC and include the three main conversions in the invite? For example, Apr 6 at 14:00 UTC (which is 10:00 ET / 16:00 CEST / 22:00 SGT).

- That keeps things unambiguous even if someone's calendar handles DST differently.
- If 14:00 UTC is inconvenient for Madrid (it would be 16:00 CEST for you), we can do 09:00 UTC instead (which maps to morning in US and early evening in EU).

Marissa — if you can update the invite to a UTC time and paste the common conversions in the description, I'll include an explicit note about EU DST starting Mar 29 so folks don't get surprised.
